science.qualification: Infrared false color of the whole disc from published flux densities (De Rosa et al. (2016), ApJ 824, 121; zero points from the SVO Filter Profile Service, Table 2, HD 95086 b, apparent magnitude: NaCo L′ 16.27 +/- 0.19, GPI K1 18.99 +/- 0.2, GPI H 20.51 +/- 0.25; SVO Paranal/NACO.Lp 240.8 Jy, Gemini/GPI.K1 721.7 Jy, Gemini/GPI.H 1018.2 Jy): red NaCo L′ 3.77 µm, green GPI K1 2.029 µm, blue GPI H 1.632 µm, on one range shared with the bodies the record names. The planet is unresolved, so no map is implied. It glows with its own heat, so no lighting.
